title: Everettian Probability in Lean: Refinement-Invariant Rational Expectation
description: A Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of a decision-theoretic layer for finite-dimensional Everettian quantum mechanics. The archived release formalizes acts, refinement invariance, rational expectation, Born calibration, typed premise audits, and explicit weight-level and decision-level countermodels. It does not derive rationality from unitary dynamics alone. This record archives GitHub tag v2.2.2-journal-audit at commit 7d0bcda60d2276e20f4be9c4b605bab779adc76f. Quantum Foundations is pinned to tag v1.3.1-journal-audit at commit f773ed5694c610af055b82427da27a69d528b776, and the transitive Gleason dependency is pinned to tag v1.1.0-journal-audit at commit 5c5bc40d2e4a31a0d1b3112fcc9a3e92b2000ec5.
